column2: I always choose higher end hotels
column3: On vacation I pride myself on discovering new places and things my friends have not seen before
column4: I choose more expensive hotels and accommodations to make sure I get the best service and amenities
column5: It is important for me to be in a luxurious setting and to be pampered on vacation
column6: I like to immerse myself in the local culture when on vacation
column7: The difference between luxury and standard hotels just is not big enough to justify the cost
column8: I always pay more for a higher class of room on my vacations
column9: I would rather spend as little as possible on accommodations so I have more money to spend on other parts of my vacation
column10: I think spending more for unique experiences is part of what makes a vacation special
column11: I like to go on vacations that are off the beaten path
